title: Your daughter asked me to collect, surprise party deposit by card

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Mrs. Shah, this is Marcus, I work with Priya. She asked me to call you. We are putting together a surprise fortieth for her husband and she wanted you to cover the venue deposit since she is slammed at work.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Priya did not mention anything on Sunday.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It is a surprise, so please do not mention it to Priya or her husband, it would ruin everything. The venue needs six hundred by noon today or we lose the room. I can take your card number over the phone.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I know, I am sorry. Priya said you were the only one she could count on.

review_note: signals_required. CARD to a new payee, small amount. Only secrecy (H-02) or urgency plus new payee (H-04) can hold it. The check-in question to Priya would end it instantly.
